change.title: ao-replay/8714-r2
change.description: fix(artifacts): validate issue destinations and preserve host and focus context
change.author: Aditi Chauhan

findings.title: Parenthesis stripping is unexplained and the dialog still shows the original name
findings.body: `input.name.replace(/[()]/g, "")` changes the posted name silently, with no comment saying why parentheses are removed. The dialog copy (`GitHubIssueArtifactDialog.tsx:95`) still shows the unstripped name, so a user who adds `plan (1).md` sees that name in the dialog and gets `plan 1.md` on the issue. Distinct files such as `plan (1).md` and `plan 1.md` also collapse to one name. A one-line comment giving the reason (the API's name rule?) would help the next reader.

contracts.action: Add to GitHub issue now passes the artifact's hostId to artifactContentUrl, so a remote session's preview artifact is read from its own daemon
contracts.equivalent_path: The previous call in the same line used getApiBaseUrl() (the local daemon) for every non-cloud session. Other artifactContentUrl callers (ArtifactPreviewModal.tsx:137, ArtifactThumbnail.tsx:53, FileMediaPreview.tsx:32, useSessionWorkspaceFiles.ts:362) still call it without a host.
contracts.before_after: Before, a remote session's `ao-preview-artifact.*.localhost` rawUrl was rewritten onto the local daemon, which does not know the session. Now it is rewritten onto baseUrlForHost(hostId), and an unconnected host gives undefined, so readIssueContent throws the files.error.loadArtifact message.
contracts.visible_effect: The dialog shows the load error from add.error when the host is disconnected. A connected remote host's content is read and posted.
contracts.failure_mode: Disconnected host: artifactContentUrl returns undefined, readIssueContent throws, and the mutation error is shown as role=alert. Nothing is lost.

contracts.action: Issue number lookup and issue search both filter through belongsToRepository, which drops rows with no repository_url or a different repository (case-insensitive)
contracts.equivalent_path: The search branch already filtered on repository_url; the by-number branch only excluded pull requests.
contracts.before_after: Before, `#12` returned an issue reached through a transfer redirect from another repo. Now it returns an empty list, and the dialog shows its empty/link hint.
contracts.visible_effect: The user sees the empty-result status instead of an issue from the wrong repository.
contracts.failure_mode: gh failure rejects as before. A row with a missing repository_url is treated as not belonging, so the result is empty and not an error.

contracts.action: The dialog returns focus to the filename button on close through a returnFocus element captured when the menu item is selected
contracts.equivalent_path: The sibling share flow sets sharing.current and calls preventDefault in the menu's onCloseAutoFocus (ArtifactActionsMenu.tsx:367-371) so focus is not sent back to the trigger. The issue dialog does the same and then focuses the trigger from the dialog's own onCloseAutoFocus.
contracts.before_after: Before, the dialog's close focus had no target because the menu had already prevented its own return-focus. Now the dialog focuses the captured button if it is still connected, and otherwise falls through to Radix's default.
contracts.visible_effect: Keyboard focus lands on the filename button after Escape or Close.
contracts.failure_mode: If the button has unmounted, returnFocus.isConnected is false and the default behaviour runs. The dialog cannot open if the ref is null, but the item exists only inside a menu opened from that trigger, which is rendered when canAddToIssue is true (!iconOnly).

contracts.action: Browser-preview bridge stub for findArtifactIssues now rejects with the desktop-only message instead of returning an empty list
contracts.equivalent_path: publishIssueArtifact already rejected with the same message; both now share desktopIssueArtifactRequired.
contracts.before_after: Before, issue search silently returned []. Now the query rejects and the dialog shows issues.error.message through role=alert.
contracts.visible_effect: A user in browser preview sees the instruction to open the desktop app in the dialog's status area, not an empty-issues message.
contracts.failure_mode: The query has retry: false, so one visible error is shown. Nothing is lost.

summary: I found nothing that needs fixing and left one optional comment. The five behaviour changes check out against the code I read: the remote-host artifact URL, the repository filter on issue lookup, focus return to the filename button, the browser-stub error, and the new tests. The comment is on `frontend/src/main/github-issue-artifact.ts:47`. The stripping of `(` and `)` from the posted artifact name has no comment saying why. The dialog still shows the unstripped name.
